title: vox-harvest-little-planes-and-engineering-sprint-notes-2026-09-15
content:
Purpose: quick harvest of recent customer threads (last 6 weeks) + compact translation into engineering lanes (little planes = low-effort probes that can be flown fast). This is a working compact for eng/product to triage and slot into next two sprints.

Topline summary (one paragraph): Customers keep surfacing three related friction patterns: (1) sporadic latency spikes on longer prompts / chat sessions that invalidate session-level caching, (2) surprise cost from unexpected token regen in multi-step flows, and (3) brittle fallback behavior when a preferred hosted model is unavailable. Many ask items are low-effort UI or routing changes; a few require runtime/kv-cache fixes.

Representative vignettes (annotated):
- Large fintech customer: multi-turn credit-decision chat; sees 300–600ms extra p99 on turns >1024 tokens. Affects UX (spinner restarts) and causes session replays. Linked note: customer thread in Slack (CS thread TL#834).
- Marketplace startup: noticed embedding staleness when switching between private deployment and hosted models — alignment/confidence drops. They want deterministic model routing (pin-by-project) to avoid drift. Jira: CS-4321.
- Platform team (internal): wants per-route cost alerts tied to token delta (regen vs new) to trigger routing to cheaper quantized variants for non-critical routes.

Candidate little planes (fast experiments, ~1–5 dev days):
- Plane A: Add per-session prefix length histogram in Console for recent 24h (dashboard tile). Low risk, infra + front-end; helps customers self-diagnose long-turn latency. Effort: 2d.
- Plane B: Expose token-regeneration flag in hosted API with opt-in header for 'no-regen' that returns error instead of regen when model misfires (works as safety valve). Effort: 3d + API docs.
- Plane C: Route-level fallback policy toggle in Console: prefer-region vs prefer-cost — UI toggle + simple policy change in router. Effort: 4d.

Engineering asks that need backend work (medium effort, 1–4 weeks):
- KV-cache boundary check and re-use: customers report cache thrash when prefix + new-turn boundary not recognized. Proposal: add a short-lived suffix-match heuristic (score-based) to consider overlapping KV segments before full recompute. Risks: potential memory overhead; requires perf testing. Owner suggestion: serving-runtime. Links: PRK-21 (prototype).
- Token-delta telemetry + billing mapping: we need clearer token provenance (regen vs original) surfaced to cost dashboards and webhook alerts. This requires tagging at router/runtime and a linkage to billing pipelines. Owner: console-and-observability.

Prioritization (rough):
- High (H): Plane A dashboard tile, Token-delta telemetry, Route-level fallback toggle — directly reduces customer pain with small-to-medium effort.
- Medium (M): KV-cache heuristic (needs perf validation), 'no-regen' header (policy review).
- Low (L): Embedding pin-by-project automation (requires product/legal on private deployments).

Customer impact scoring rubric (ad-hoc):
- Severity: UX-disrupting latency (3), Extra cost shock (2), Security/locked deployment concerns (1).
- Reach: number of customers reporting or impacted in last 30 days. We used 1–5 scale.

Example mapping: fintech vignette -> Severity 3, Reach 2 -> prioritize KV-cache boundary (+ Plane A). Marketplace embedding -> Severity 2, Reach 1 -> prioritize routing pin toggle and product policy.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Do we accept a temporary 'no-regen' header given function-calling and tool-calls semantics? (Security/Product)
- Can serving-runtime allocate the extra memory headroom for suffix-match heuristics without violating Dedicated capacity SLOs? (SRE/Product)
- Should token-delta be part of default billing export or an opt-in advanced telemetry? (Finance/CS)

Suggested owner/hand-off for next steps:
- CS (Maya) will schedule a 30-min sync with serving-runtime guild and console PM next week.
- Diego to draft the short customer-facing KB (how-to reduce latency spikes) once Plane A dashboard tile is live.
- Priya to validate legal/contract constraints for embedding pins on Private deployments.

Notes-to-self (informal):
- Include sample prompt snippets from fintech customer (redact PII) in Slack thread CS-834; they help reproduce long-turn pattern.
- Put a 2-week smoke test for KV-cache heuristic behind a canary rollout to Dedicated only.

References / links (scratch):
- Confluence quick: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/vox-harvest-landing
- Repro gist (internal): https://gist.github.com/maya/kv-cache-minirepro
- Jira: CS-4321, CS-834, SRE-770

End. This doc is intentionally terse; we expect it to be expanded into a product brief if owners greenlight the high-priority planes.
